An '''apas connector''' was part of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster's]] inner mechanism. It was connected to the [[power flux dispersion unit]]. The apas connectors allowed excess flashback energy from the weapon's discharge to be channelled into the dispersion unit, allowing it to dissipate.<ref name="CRFG" />
